title: Selling prices of crop products (absolute prices) - annual price (from 2000 onwards)
parentTitle: Selling prices of agricultural products (absolute prices)
search_text: time frequency currency vegetable product geopolitical entity (reporting) means of agricultural production general and regional statistics agricultural production agricultural products agricultural product agricultural prices means of production regional statistics econometric model national currency the member states vegetable product decision-making economic models characteristic agricultural prices are crucial variables for the purposes of decision-making in economic activities, as they provide basic information for many socio-economic models calculation, econometric modelling or to determinate price elasticities. eurostat collects and publishes agricultural absolute prices the "output" price is the average price received by farmers on the market for an agricultural commodity, produced within a specified 12-month period. this price is measured at the farm gate, i.e. at the point where the commodity leaves the farm and, therefore, does not cover the costs for transport
